messages:
Priya (devex): Quick note: encountered SDK vs REST divergence on embeddings -> headers + retry semantics. Repro below. Anyone in embedders on call?

Ethan: what's diverging exactly?

Priya (devex): SDK (node@1.4.3) strips top-level "client_ref" and nests it under "meta" for batch path. curl shows top-level client_ref accepted and echoed back. Also SDK returns 429 error immediately, REST queues and gives 202+queue_id for the same payload.

Mark: do you have the raw request bodies? headers?

Priya (devex): yes. curl payload (works): {"model":"rwd-embed-1","inputs":["p","q"],"client_ref":"onboard-123"}

Priya (devex): SDK payload (broken): {"model":"rwd-embed-1","inputs":["p","q"],"meta":{"client_ref":"onboard-123"}}

Ethan: that explains echo mismatch. Why would generator put client_ref under meta? We flattened fields last cycle.

Priya (devex): suspect codegen template mismatch. Also noticed SDK sends Accept: */* and content-type with charset; server uses Accept to decide streaming fallback and enqueuing for big batches.

ops-bot: Incident-fyi: sample-app onboarding rate increased errors 15% in the last 2h.

Mark: two bugfixes: 1) serializer must emit client_ref at top-level for batch path; 2) retry policy must match REST: on 429/503 for embeddings, attempt 3 retries with exponential backoff and jitter and allow server enqueue (202). Add a compatibility flag for Dedicated users.

Priya (devex): opened issue #1877 with captures and minimal repro: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/1877. Tagging @Ethan for serializer, @Mark for retry policy.

Ethan: I'll add unit tests asserting exact JSON body and header expectations; will mock httptest to ensure server receives top-level client_ref. Branch fix/embed-serializer.

Mark: I'll update retry config and add integration test that asserts SDK handles 202 + queue_id and fires webhook handler in sample-app.

Priya (devex): Can we cut a patch release if tests pass? Onboarding is broken for a lot of customers.

Ethan: yes, aim for patch 1.4.4.

Priya (devex): thanks — will post PR links and staging canary results here.
